title: Access the dashboard overview after signing in
description: An authenticated creator can sign in and land on the overview page with dashboard metrics and shortcuts visible.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Navigate to /overview
Verify dashboard summary metrics are displayed
Verify dashboard navigation shortcuts are displayed
